notes:
{相当|そうとう} can function as an adverb, na-adjective, or suru verb.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {相当|そうとう}する

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Adverb: {相当|そうとう} + adjective/verb (considerably)
- Na-adjective: {相当|そうとう}な + noun (considerable)
- Suru verb: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{相当|そうとう}する (be equivalent to)
- {相当|そうとう}⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ (quite difficult)
- {相当|そうとう}な⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (considerable amount)
- X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{相当|そうとう}する (be equivalent to X)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧: fairly, considerably (casual)
- {相当|そうとう}: considerably (slightly more formal)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}に→非常に：01223_hijouni⟧: extremely (stronger)
